name: decided-test-rows
brief: Clear seven .sir/backlog.md rows whose remedy the 20261118-0114-backlog-triage gates already chose, all inside the test projects: drop the two Task.Delay waits in EntityEqualityTests and FloorMethodsTests by backdating LastModified through reflection; trim ThemeSource's dead surface (ThemeFileText, the two key patterns and their pin test) and make ThemeDirectory and StaticResourceKeys private; comment the Assert.NotEmpty guard in FloorMapDrawableDisposalTests; widen ThemeHygieneTests to report bare FontSize and FontFamily Setters outside Resources/Theme, with a synthetic control; record the allocation test's blind spot to unconditional per-frame allocations in its remark; rename the singular Area, Dungeon and Floor test folders and namespaces to plural, dropping aliases the singular forced; and pin the FluentValidation 12.1.1 version in the NonFiniteScaleRejectionTests remark. No production code changes. The rows are removed from the backlog at Gate 3.
